label: lem:row-quotient-geometry
scope: Finite-dimensional centered energy, the vector pairwise-variance identity, the direct pair-distance bound, and the centered-energy collapse implication.
excluded: Attainment of the finite maximum, the reverse diameter-to-energy bound, and the three-way sequence equivalence.

label: thm:layer-resolved-gate-shape
scope: The finite nonnegative coordinate factorization and equivalence between total-energy convergence and convergence of every mixed coordinate energy.
excluded: Matrix row centering, Frobenius column assembly, and transfer to maximum physical row diameter.

label: thm:block-orbit-criterion
paper: Necessary and sufficient block orbit criterion
scope: Attained finite block maxima, exact anchor-plus-excursion identity, the nonnegative block collapse equivalence, and domination by positive variation.
excluded: Passage from successive unbounded blocks to the complete natural-number orbit and the finite-registry maximum.

label: thm:implemented-adamw-lift
scope: The abstract three-block lifted state action and its block expansion. The same additive forcing cancels in the difference of two affine responses; this is a ring identity.
excluded: Construction of live Hessian, clipping, bias-correction, denominator, and decay blocks from the implemented optimizer.

label: prop:gate-zero-invariance
scope: The scalar adaptive-write zero criterion and its reduction to a zero clipped gradient when the incoming first moment vanishes.
excluded: The coordinatewise AdamW denominator construction and the final physical gate-shape alternative.

label: thm:observable-complete-state
scope: Exact chronological state and observable decompositions in additive groups, with separate transported force and remainder and a componentwise vanishing sufficient condition.
excluded: Finite-registry row geometry, differentiable observation remainders, the norm envelope, the Gram cancellation identity, and the necessary-and-sufficient limit wording.

label: thm:finite-increment-observable-balance
scope: Exact chronological accumulation of finite-state correction and the three-term additive observable balance at a fixed horizon.
excluded: Route labels, differentiability interpretations, numerical effect floors, cross-Gram diagnostics, and empirical cancellation classification.

label: prop:stratified-itinerary
scope: No formal coverage is claimed.
excluded: Route-dependent chart spaces, nonsmooth compatible linear maps, and separation of exact algebra from routewise remainder regularity.

label: thm:lower-metric-transfer
scope: A uniform positive lower comparison transfers convergence of a nonnegative scheduled quantity to convergence of the fixed quantity without an upper comparison.
excluded: Matrix-valued metrics, extraction of square-root norm inequalities, and variable chart dimensions.

label: thm:scheduled-tube-collapse
scope: A nonnegative scheduled state below a vanishing chronological affine envelope converges to zero without a fixed-metric comparison.
excluded: Variable-radius tube induction, scheduled induced norms, quadratic remainder construction, and separation of the two chronological limits.

label: cor:scheduled-cover-collapse
scope: A vanishing nonnegative scheduled state and baseline transfer through a uniform linear physical cover.
excluded: Finite-registry row-diameter geometry and a uniform context-class supremum.

label: cor:fixed-norm-collapse-transfer
scope: Lower-metric transfer followed by a fixed-norm physical cover, with no upper scheduled-metric comparison.
excluded: Matrix-valued metrics, square-root extraction, and finite-registry row-diameter geometry.

label: thm:finite-cocycle-envelope
scope: Chronological finite iteration of the nonnegative affine scalar estimate used after the nonlinear tube bound.
excluded: The tube induction, scheduled norms, and finite physical-cover maximum.

label: cor:continuous-observable
scope: No formal coverage is claimed.
excluded: Fundamental propagators, the Duhamel formula, observation transport, and any discrete-to-continuous scaling limit.

label: cor:linear-stochastic-forcing
scope: No formal coverage is claimed.
excluded: Martingale orthogonality, the transported second-moment bound, and its mean-square consequence.

label: thm:collapse-obstructions
scope: Necessity of vanishing realized force, its contrapositive obstruction, and an explicit finite-prefix reopening counterexample.
excluded: The degenerating scheduled-metric counterexample.

label: thm:linear-observation-kernel-obstruction
scope: A persistent nonzero common-kernel vector gives identically zero linear observations and a nonconvergent constant state path.
excluded: Time-varying observation codomains and embedding into a particular optimizer recurrence.

label: prop:nonlinear-zero-fiber-obstruction
paper: Nonlinear zero-fiber obstruction and derivative caveat
scope: The constant-path obstruction for a common nonlinear zero fiber and the scalar-square counterexample separating a zero derivative from a nonlinear zero fiber.
excluded: Time-varying codomains, Fréchet derivatives in general normed spaces, and the physical row-map observation formula.

label: thm:plga-quotient-defect
scope: The abstract response-plus-defect bound, exact reduction at zero upstream quotient, and obstruction from a nonzero constant-input defect.
excluded: The implemented PLGA formula, segment integral construction of the response bound, and sequential transfer.

label: prop:plga-row-preservation
scope: No formal coverage is claimed.
excluded: Propagation of row constancy through the five implemented PLGA parameter conditions.
